How Lantern Lab uses it
-----------------------
Every page includes, with the right relative path:

    <script data-goatcounter="https://lanternlab.goatcounter.com/count" async src="../vendor/goatcounter/count.js"></script>

What count.js sends (verified against this copy):
- p: location.pathname + location.search, or the <link rel="canonical">
  path when the canonical URL is on the same host. Never location.hash.
- q: location.search. GoatCounter reads campaigns from it server side
  (utm_campaign/campaign; source from utm_source, ref, src or source).
- r: document.referrer (browsers never include the fragment).
- t: document.title. Pages whose title can be built from link-hash data
  pin a fixed title with data-goatcounter-settings.
- s: screen width, b: bot flag, rnd: cache buster.
It is sent with navigator.sendBeacon (CSP connect-src) and falls back to an
<img> beacon (CSP img-src), so pages allow https://lanternlab.goatcounter.com
in both. No cookies are set.

Updating: replace count.js with the upstream file, update the lines above,
then run node bots/analytics/check.js.
